&PlayerName, /what you wear is a mark of virtue.
In the fleeting dreams i catch, once dreamt and now released to the cosmos
 /I see fascination for those who produced such an artefact.
I longed to reveal this truth for time untold.
/We were known to /eachother// as/// Alchemists.
The First men to come to this world.
The First Friends I've /ever /had /the privilege of naming as such.
